subject.character: ONE sleepy adult male koala; inky right paw; cheek bulging with eucalyptus leaves; cowbell on his neck; on his belly a clear four-cup milking machine, its hose slack on the ground back into depth, smooth gold discs gurgling away along it; same face throughout
subject.anti_action: weary serious face, brisk dry talker; the mouth talks, never chews; nobody touches him while he talks

second_characters: ONE Australian magpie, at the bottom edge, never over his face; ONE possum; ONE echidna
props: bark strips, cups, bucket, discs: blank, no markings
environment: eucalyptus grove as a milking yard: wooden stalls, buckets on hooks, hoses up the trunks; dense background
lighting: low sunset sun behind-left rims his fur gold, warm magenta sky glow rims him from behind-right, high contrast, bright; at 8.95 the sun flares across the lens
motion_rule: He waddles straight at the lens in every beat, the camera backs away before him. New shot size every beat. Dense yard. Side characters act one at a time.

audio.delivery: flat low brisk male voice, native, no accent; first word on frame one
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once, inside its beat, no speech after 7.5; silent beats: no voice, no moo
